title: Core: FLA round-trip preserves symbol timeline content
description: Round-trip test that FLA save/load preserves a Symbol's full timeline: a MovieClip symbol with 3 layers, 5 frames, frame labels, a ShapeDisplayObject on frame 0. After loadFla, verify symbol exists in library, has correct layerCount, frameCount, displayObjects at frame 0. Tests in packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/symbol-timeline-roundtrip.test.ts.
